message: みんなの心をつなぐため

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, it's that girl from the other day.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's here again. I wonder what she's doing.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This time, make sure you actually talk to her.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Letting your ulterior motives spill out so you can't even hide them--that's Synn-sama for ya.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is something the matter in a place like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Actually, it's about that girl from the other day.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We were just wondering how to get her to talk.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. So, where is this person?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't know anyone like that! Hmph!」
「What should I do from here on...」
「S-S-Sorry! I thought nobody was here, so I just!」

name: Macaron
message: 「More importantly, did something happen? Are you hungry?」

name: Macaron
message: 「If you want, I can hear you out.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I can't just leave someone in trouble alone, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan, could you pass me those documents over there?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, apparently she's been like this all morning.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if it really has something to do with that girl...」

name: Synn
message: 「She seemed like an acquaintance of Lolotte's, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Both of them looked pretty awkward, didn't they.」

name: Misa
message: 「Aren't they just having a fight or something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't make a fool out of me!」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, it really does make you curious...」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me is curious about Ria-chan's big apples!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh? Like I'd know anything about angels.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I keep telling you, I'm not an angel!」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well, work's settled down a bit, so how about we take a break?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I see. So things are kinda awkward between you and that Lolotte girl.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then it'll be fine! Just leave it to the great Lady Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I just had a little something I wanted to ask you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's okay. My big bro is the Student Council President, so he's that Lolotte girl's boss.」

name: Macaron
message: 「He's harmless despite how he looks, so don't worry.」

name: Synn
message: 「Just how do I look to people......」

name: Macaron
message: 「And if he tries anything funny, I'll slice him right in half for you♪」

name: Synn
message: 「So you really were Lolotte's friend after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm Synn Sakura. Nice to meet you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well then, let's hear the details inside.」

name: Synn
message: 「You act just like this is your own house.」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's cold outside, isn't it. Come on, get inside, get inside.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's nothing special, but please, have some tea.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Um, well, I think its astringency is rather nice.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte and I are, um, childhood friends, but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, sorry. Which girl in the Student Council was Lolotte again.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm? If you're childhood friends, could it be that you're also, Amyrina...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「N-N-No, I'm not! I'm not an angel!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「M-M-M-More importantly! Please listen to what I came to talk about.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I came here to tell Lolotte something really important.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「When Lolotte was leaving to come here, we ended up getting into a fight right as we parted ways...」

name: Synn
message: 「...So you didn't get to say a proper goodbye, huh.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「And I haven't been able to get in touch with her at all since then...」

name: Synn
message: 「I bet Lolotte's been beating herself up over it too.」

name: Macaron
message: 「You want to make up and have a proper talk with her, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「All righty then! Leave it to the great Macaron to lend a helping hand.」

name: Synn
message: 「I get the gist of what happened, but why are you getting involved, Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're really one to talk, Big Brother?」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's so everyone can be happy, duh. Fighting and leaving people out is no good, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, it doesn't feel good to just leave someone in trouble alone!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, even you have a few things worth learning from, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ugh, geez! Stop laughing like a creep!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Anyway! Just leave the rest to the great Demon Lord Macaron!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, I'm still kind of, sorta in training, though!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, you're not gonna get anything out of me by flattering me!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Um, what do you mean by 'Demon Lord'... ?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! Macaron isn't plotting world domination or anything like that at all!」

name: Macaron
message: 「What is that, the imagination of a water flea?」

name: Synn
message: 「She's a good Demon Lord who makes everyone happy. There's nothing wrong with having a Demon Lord like that!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I don't really understand, but... she sounds like a wonderful person.」
Does Amyrina not know anything about Demon Lords...?

name: Macaron
message: 「Alright, let's go make up tomorrow right away!」

name: Macaron
message: 「With this kind of thing, the sooner the better, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm counting on you too, big brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll burn into those eyes of yours that I'm a magnificent Demon Lord!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Alright, tomorrow we're gonna make up nice and clean!」

name: Macaron
message: 「No good, no good, not like that.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Neither you, big brother, nor Miss Angel has enough spirit!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「L-Like I said, I told you I'm not an angel~!」
Macaron mediating between people who aren't Demons, huh.
Somehow, I feel like her vibe has changed just a little from when we first met.
That's probably a good thing, right...
